scope: Define DEV, TEST, RESEARCH, DEMO, SHADOW, CANARY and LIVE logical environment contracts
Define base configuration and per-environment overlays
Define machine-readable environment configuration schema and policy
Define deterministic config precedence and merge semantics

Forbid runtime overrides from changing safety, execution or credential-authority controls
Keep all environment provisioning state CONTRACT_ONLY in P04-D
Keep CANARY/LIVE activation disabled and credential authority unprovisioned
Keep SHADOW without external order submission

Validate config contracts in the already-required governance CI gate
